name: Monasteries of Haghpat and Sanahin
description: Perched on the forested canyon slopes above Alaverdi in northern Armenia, Haghpat and Sanahin are two neighbouring monastery complexes built between the 10th and 13th centuries. Their dark stone churches, chapels and halls blend Byzantine design with local Caucasian building traditions. Sanahin was also famed for its school of manuscript illuminators and calligraphers, and both monasteries were major centres of learning.
